niche_preference_profile: This user consistently prefers interfaces with strong, legible hierarchy, clear sectioning, and purposeful grouping; layouts that feel spacious but still populated with concrete, actionable content; and polished, expressive styling that can range from soft editorial light themes to dramatic dark premium themes depending on context. They repeatedly favor real-world or integrated visual treatments, stronger card/module structure, and screens that make actions and content feel tangible rather than empty, generic, or flat.

criteria.description: Prefers clear headline emphasis, distinct section labels, and obvious separation between content levels so the screen reads in a deliberate top-down flow.
Prefers content organized into clearly defined cards, grouped modules, or segmented sections rather than flat undifferentiated canvases or weak row separation.
Prefers open spacing, calmer vertical rhythm, and generous margins that reduce clutter and make the interface feel easier to scan.
Prefers screens that feel concrete and useful through visible items, detailed identities or status information, and obvious actions rather than empty states or abstract placeholders.

Prefers refined, distinctive presentation with personality—such as integrated imagery, real photos, layered depth, softer premium surfaces, or otherwise more characterful styling over generic template-like UI.
